definitions.explanation: the ability to remember or the state of remembering something; a sense of having experienced something before
a written record made as a reminder or for reference

examples.japanese: ⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧{覚|おぼ}え⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't remember saying such a thing.
I have a recollection of having met him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疑|うたが}われて→疑う：01889_utagau⟧⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I was troubled by being suspected of something I had no memory of doing.

examples.japanese: {覚|おぼ}え{書|が}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{覚|おぼ}え{書|が}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: I compiled the contents of the meeting into a memorandum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧なこと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{覚|おぼ}え{書|が}きにして⟦{残|のこ}して→残す：01975_nokosu⟧おこう。
examples.english: Let's put important things down in notes so they're preserved.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {覚|おぼ}える (to remember). In sense 1, it refers to the subjective feeling or awareness of remembering something. In sense 2, it refers to a written note or memorandum.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have a memory of, to recall
- {覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no memory of, to not recall
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: to have no recollection of doing something (strong denial)
- {覚|おぼ}え{書|が}き: memorandum, written notes

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: quick to learn
- {覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: slow to learn, having poor memory
- {覚|おぼ}え⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦めでたい→めでたい：17687_medetai⟧: to be in someone's good graces, to be well-regarded

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧: memory — more formal, refers to the faculty or stored content of memory
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧: memories, reminiscence — emphasizes nostalgic or emotional recollection
